raw_pdf_evidence_obtained.claim: BP 344 2024 supports accessible ramp 1200 mm minimum clear width, 1:20 general gradient, 1:15 special-case row, and 1800 mm ramp landings.

raw_pdf_evidence_obtained.evidence_excerpt: Minimum clear width of 1200 mm ... Gradient not steeper than 1:20 ... 1:15 10.50m 700mm 10m ... minimum length of 1800 mm.

raw_pdf_evidence_obtained.claim: BP 344 2024 supports sidewalks/walkways 1500 mm minimum width and 1800 mm where two wheelchairs must pass.
raw_pdf_evidence_obtained.source_locator: BP 344 2024 Revised IRR, Appendix B, Pathways, Sidewalks and Walkways
raw_pdf_evidence_obtained.evidence_excerpt: Sidewalks, walkways, and pathways shall have a minimum width of 1500 millimeters. Where space is required for two wheelchairs to pass, the minimum width shall be 1800 mm.

raw_pdf_evidence_obtained.claim: PD 1096 supports 1.10 m minimum corridor or exit balcony width for required exits serving occupant load over 10.
raw_pdf_evidence_obtained.source_locator: PD 1096 2004 Revised IRR, Rule XII, Section 1207, Corridors and Exterior Exit Balconies
raw_pdf_evidence_obtained.evidence_excerpt: Every corridor or exit balcony shall not be less than 1.10 meters in width.

raw_pdf_evidence_obtained.claim: PD 1096 states exit ramp width shall be as required for corridors.
raw_pdf_evidence_obtained.source_locator: PD 1096 2004 Revised IRR, Rule XII, Section 1207, Ramps
raw_pdf_evidence_obtained.evidence_excerpt: A ramp conforming to the provisions of the Code may be used as an exit. The width of ramps shall be as required for corridors.
